crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Ovoid patch of orange-rufous coloration on the posterior neck/upper mantle region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse grayscale transition between the uniform gray crown and mantle plumage.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white ovoid spots arranged on the black rectrices and scattered small white spots on the gray wing coverts.
